resolved_conflicts.explanation: Starr's list says the tower is owned by Marty Podskoch and on loan to civic leaders in the village of Speculator; Wikipedia says the Town of Speculator owns it now. Neither source dates its account, so the story reports both.

Starr's list and the Forest Lookouts page say Hooker Hill (2,320 ft); Wikipedia says Hooker Mountain (2,310 ft). The NGS survey mark uses a separate name for a nearby mark. The story uses Hooker Hill.

NGS datasheet for mark NA2101, HOOKER 2 RESET

notes_for_editor: Ownership conflict: Starr's list (file dated 3-14-11) names Marty Podskoch; Wikipedia names the Town of Speculator with no date. Both are in the story. The NGS datasheet's description date is not shown in the text read; the datasheet was retrieved today, and its description is the only current account of the site. Name: Hooker Hill (Starr, Forest Lookouts) vs Hooker Mountain (Wikipedia). Facebook posts from the FFLA NY chapter and a Maryland historical group appeared in search results, including a claim the tower was disassembled; they were not used because they are unverified. Access: no source states whether the land is open, so no access fact or visit instruction is recorded. The 1975 sale and the 2001 transfer rest on Wikipedia; its reference list was not read in full.
